title: eludite.browser.tabs output
description: Whether the browser runs, which engine it is, and its tabs in the order they were opened.

name.description: `embedded-chromium`: Eludite's own Chromium (`eludite-chromium` on CEF, brief 0031), drawn in the Web Browser window; `external-chrome`: a Chrome or Chromium process Eludite launched (brief 0023). The setting browser.engine chooses.

version.description: The browser's product and version from Browser.getVersion (`HeadlessChrome/141.0.7390.37`); present while it runs.

executable.description: The executable launched; present while it runs.

sandbox.description: The embedded engine's sandbox while it runs (brief 0039): `namespaces` (unprivileged user namespaces), `helper` (the setuid chrome-sandbox), or `none` (--no-sandbox, after the workspace's opt-in browser.allowNoSandbox or ELUDITE_CHROME_NO_SANDBOX=1; the Web Browser window shows a strip meanwhile). Absent for the external Chrome.

cef.description: The CEF folder the embedded engine runs with; present while it runs.

found_by.description: How the embedded engine and its CEF were found, the first that held them (brief 0039): the engine by the setting browser.enginePath (`setting`), ELUDITE_CHROMIUM (`variable`), beside the eludite executable (`beside`) or cargo's build folder (`dev`); CEF beside the engine (`beside`), at ELUDITE_CEF or CEF_PATH (`variable`), or in tools/cef/fetch.sh's cache (`cache`). Present while it runs.

active.description: The active tab's id; absent when there is none.

target_id.description: The page's Chrome DevTools Protocol target id, as the browser's remote debugging port lists it (`/json/list`): what a debugger attaches to (eludite.debug.attach with `tab`; brief 0038). Absent when the engine does not say.

active.description: The tab commands act on when they are given no `tab`.

loading.description: The main frame is loading (between Page.frameStartedLoading and frameStoppedLoading).

page_generation.description: The tab's page generation: it grows when the main frame navigates or the document is replaced (DOM.documentUpdated). Refs are valid only in the generation that issued them.

favicon.description: The page's icon as a data url (embedded engine), when it has one.

can_go_back.description: navigate with `action: back` has somewhere to go.

session.description: The debugging session whose launch opened this tab (brief 0037): its id (eludite.debug.sessions) and its project's name. Restarting the session navigates this tab; ending it leaves the tab open.
